lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The most distinct group consists of four spots arranged in a quasi-linear horizontal sequence posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersect with the lateral spots to form a series of grid-like nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a light-to-shadow gradient running longitudinally across the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete, high-luminance blobs distributed with low density across the anterior and mid-sections of the dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense population of small-diameter high-intensity spots located on the proximal and distal regions of the pectoral fin.
